text.tspan: Simplified sequence: Pending list and single-request review. JSP views are leave-request-list.jsp and leave-request-review.jsp. Controller checks session and CSRF for POST.
createManagerFilter(keyword, status, position, leaveType, fromDate, toDate)
Service converts rows to LeaveRequestItemView, loads groups/approval summaries and grouped review parts as needed; then wraps items in PageResult.

For Pending requests, call LeaveApprovalService.review(conn, request, workingPosition): annual quota, minimum staffing and Scheduled PT sessions. Attach checks, staffing rows, blocking message and group to the view.

Begin transaction; lockDecisionScope and validateDecision: Working Manager + existing Pending request. Late approval needs a 5–500 character reason. validateApproval delegates to LeaveApprovalService.review(...).
If allowed and updated: auditLogService.logInTransaction(...). If a validation fails or update returns false: rollback and return a failure, not the success path below.
Success toast; redirect to validated returnUrl or leave list
Validate reason 5–500 characters and Working Manager. Begin transaction, lock and re-read Pending request; reject does not require approval quota/staffing checks.
After successful update: write audit log in the same transaction. Validation/update failure returns a failure after rollback.
Success toast; redirect to validated returnUrl or leave list

POST failure: controller preserves reason/errors and reloads the review JSP. SQL/runtime transaction errors roll back. Bulk approval is described separately below; it is not one UPDATE for every selected ID.

Validate IDs and remove duplicates. For each ID call approveRequest(managerAccountId, id): one transaction per request; collect approvedCount and failedRequests. Late approval without a reason fails for that request.
Store bulk result in session; redirect to list for one-time result display
